task: Write a Python function that takes an S3 bucket name and a prefix, and returns the total size in bytes of all objects under that prefix using boto3 pagination.
Create a JSON IAM policy document that allows read-only access (s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket) to a single S3 bucket named 'analytics-reports' and denies any s3:DeleteObject actions on that bucket.
Write a regex that matches valid AWS ARNs for IAM roles in the format arn:aws:iam::<12-digit-account-id>:role/<role-name>, capturing the account ID and role name as groups.
